title: Nissan North America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (328,318 affected)
summary: THE LEFT SIDE FUEL TANK SUPPORT COULD BECOME RUSTY IF VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN AREAS WHERE SALT IS USED FOR SNOW REMOVAL. SUPPORT MAY RUST ENTIRELY THROUGH, ALLOWING TANK TO TILT DOWN ON THE LEFT SIDE.

title: FLEETWOOD ENTERPRISES, INC.: WHEELS:CAP:COVER:HUB (841 affected)
summary: THE DECORATIVE WHEEL COVERS MAY CONTACT THE TIRE SIDEWALLS RESULTING IN DAMAGE TO THE TIRES.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS (3,785 affected)
summary: LOCATION OF HYDRAULIC BRAKE TUBE TO BOTH REAR WHEELS CAUSES INTERFERENCE AND CHAFING BETWEEN THE TUBES AND REAR SUSPENSION TRAILING ARM PIVOT BRACKETS.

title: redundant YAMAHA INTERNATIONAL CORP: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:MOTORCYCLES ONLY (8,669 affected)
summary: FRONT WHEEL BRAKE SHOES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MACHINED PROPERLY. THE FRONT WHEEL COMPRESSION BAR AND ONE OF ITS COMPONENTS, A BUSHING, ALONG WITH THE BRAKE CABLE MAY BECOME DAMAGED AND DISPLACED.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:PLY (977 affected)
summary: TIRES WERE INADVERTENTLY MANUFACTURED WITH THE SECOND PLY ONE-HALF INCH OFF CENTER. TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SEPARATION OF THE REINFORCING PLIES AND RUBBER COMPOUND IN THE SIDEWALL AREA.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:PLY (786 affected)
summary: TIRES WERE INADVERTENTLY MANUFACTURED WITH THE SECOND PLY ONE-HALF INCH OFF CENTER. TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SEPARATION OF THE REINFORCING PLIES AND RUBBER COMPOUND IN THE SIDEWALL AREA. TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE HIGH SPEED REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".

title: EXCALIBUR AUTO CORP.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (75 affected)
summary: THE BEAD CHAIN, WHICH CONNECTS THE SPEED CONTROL DEVICE TO THE THROTTLE ARM OF THE CARBURETOR, WAS INSTALLED WITHOUT A COVER. UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, SUCH AS WHEN TRAVELING ON AN INCLINE, THE CHAIN COULD WRAP AROUND THE THROTTLE ARM AND HOLD THE THROTTLE HALF OPEN.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (610,000 affected)
summary: DOOR LOCK PILLARS COULD DEVELOP FATIGUE CRACKS FROM NORMAL USAGE OF DOOR, AT THE POINT WHERE DOOR LATCH STRIKER REINFORCEMENTS ARE ATTACHED.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: TIRES:EMERGENCY SPARE TIRE (32,000 affected)
summary: TIRES MAY NOT BE CAPABLE OF CARRYING THEIR FULL RATED LOAD. THIS COULD LEAD TO SEPARATION OF THE RUBBER COMPOUND IN THE SIDEWALL AREAS. TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE LABELING AND ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109. "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".
